title: MEDAGENTS: A Multi-disciplinary Collaboration Framework for Medical Question Answering

defines.name: MEDAGENTS
defines.definition: A training-free multi-agent framework that uses role-playing LLM experts in multi-round discussion to improve medical reasoning and reach a consensus answer.

problem: LLMs struggle with medical tasks because of limited domain-specific training data, specialized terminology, and the need for strong domain knowledge and reasoning.
